title: Raja's win leaked before air
summary: Before Season 3 aired, Perez Hilton publicly revealed Raja as the winner. The leak prompted production to change crowning formats from Season 4 onward, filming multiple finale outcomes to prevent spoilers.

title: First double shantay: Mickey Spanish
summary: In Life, Liberty and the Pursuit of Style (US-S03-E09), Carmen Carrera and Yara Sofia lip-synced to Toni Basil's "Mickey" (Spanish version). Both won and no one was eliminated — the show's first double shantay.

title: Carmen Carrera voted back in
summary: After Carmen Carrera was eliminated in RuPaul-a-palooza (US-S03-E10), the judges voted her back into the competition for Jocks in Frocks (US-S03-E12). She was eliminated again that same episode after lip-syncing against Raja.

title: Raja wins Season 3
summary: In the Grand Finale (US-S03-E15), Alexis Mateo was eliminated before the crown lip-sync. Raja and Manila Luzon lip-synced to "Champion (DJ BunJoe's Olympic Mix)"; Raja was crowned. The Season 3 cash prize was $75,000.

title: Yara Sofia Miss Congeniality
summary: Yara Sofia was voted Miss Congeniality by viewers, announced at the Season 3 reunion (US-S03-E16).
